'''Star Tours Flight 1121''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1B at 1125 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1220.
